detail.longDescription: 🚀 DebGen is back after a long hiatus, rebuilt from scratch and live again at https:// debgen.org/ A Debian sources list generator: pick a release and your repos, and get modern DEB822 .sources files instead of one-liner hacks. 🔐 Every signing key is pinned via Signed-By to its own keyring, and every command is reviewed before it touches a terminal. No curl piped into sudo, ever. 100+ verified vendor repos covered too. 🐧 Code on GitHub: https:// github.com/MalteKiefer/debgen # Debian # Linux # OpenSource # FOSS # SelfHosted # Sysadmin # DevOps # APT # Homelab # FLOSS # Terminal # CLI
